issues.jp_before: お腹[なか]{が|ga-stative}すいている{ので|node-because}、何[なん]{でも|demo-any}おいしいです。
issues.problem: お腹 is the subject of the intransitive verb すく, not the object of a stative predicate; ga-stative is the wrong skill id.
issues.action: Changed the skill id of the が slot to ga-subject.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}、分[わ]からないこと{が|ga-existence}あれ{ば|ba-conditional}何[なん]{でも|demo-any}聞[き]いてください{と|to-quote}言[い]いました。
issues.problem: English 'ask me anything' after 'if there's anything you don't understand' was redundant and unnatural.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'ask me about anything'.

issues.jp_before: この問題[もんだい]{は|wa-topic}先生[せんせい]{さえ/すら/でも|sae-even}答[こた]えられませんでした。
issues.problem: Distractor が gives a grammatical sentence ('the teacher couldn't answer this'); it only drops the 'even', so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor が with しか (the meaning becomes 'only the teacher could answer').

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{の|no-possessive}大雪[おおゆき]{で|de-cause}、新幹線[しんかんせん]{さえ/すら|sae-even}遅[おく]れました。
issues.problem: In this positive sentence, 新幹線でも遅れました and 新幹線まで遅れました are equally natural for 'even the Shinkansen was late', but neither was listed.
issues.action: Added でも and まで as alternatives in the focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}忙[いそが]しい{ので|node-because}、家族[かぞく]{の|no-possessive}誕生日[たんじょうび]{さえ/すら|sae-even}忘[わす]れます。
issues.problem: 誕生日まで忘れます (まで meaning 'even') is equally natural in this positive sentence but was not listed.
issues.action: Added まで as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 教室[きょうしつ]{は|wa-topic}とても静[しず]かだった{ので|node-because}、鉛筆[えんぴつ]{の|no-possessive}音[おと]{さえ/すら|sae-even}聞[き]こえました。
issues.problem: 鉛筆の音まで聞こえました is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added まで as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 説明書[せつめいしょ]{を|o-object}読[よ]ん{でも|te-mo}、使[つか]い方[かた]{さえ/すら|sae-even}分[わ]かりませんでした。
issues.problem: English used 'even' twice ('Even after reading..., I didn't even understand'), which reads badly.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'Despite reading the manual, I didn't even understand how to use it.'

issues.jp_before: 郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]{は|wa-topic}土曜日[どようび]{さえ/すら/でも|sae-even}開[あ]いていません。
issues.problem: The さえ logic doesn't work: Saturday is not the day a post office would most be expected to open (post offices are usually closed then), so 'not even on Saturday' makes no sense.
issues.action: Deleted it and wrote a replacement: その子[こ]{は|wa-topic}恥[は]ずかしがって、挨拶[あいさつ]{さえ/すら|sae-even}しませんでした。 / The child was shy and didn't even say hello.
